crossRefs.note: but gave in to craving in the desert, and tested God in the wasteland.
He gave them their request, but sent leanness into their soul.
The whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron in the wilderness;
and the children of Israel said to them, “We wish that we had died by Yahweh’s hand in the land of Egypt, when we sat…
The mixed multitude that was among them lusted exceedingly; and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, “Who…
Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things, as they also lusted.
You lust, and don’t have. You murder and covet, and can’t obtain. You fight and make war. You don’t have, because you…
You ask, and don’t receive, because you ask with wrong motives, so that you may spend it on your pleasures.

translations.web: They tempted God in their heart by asking food according to their desire.
translations.bsb: They willfully tested God by demanding the food they craved.
translations.kjv: And they tempted God in their heart by asking meat for their lust.
translations.asv: And they tempted God in their heart By asking food according to their desire.
